title: Interim (C:motile-repair): c28's ringed swimmers repair a 40% front cut against exact branched twins. 7 of 8 cells re-close their link ring within 100-120 steps and regain pre-cut area in 280-340 steps; erasing only the links kills 4 of 4 cells within 100 steps
summary: On c28's ringswim-dl2 (world unchanged; deterministic after init, so a branched twin is exact), at t=10000 I picked mature, compact, moving cells: same cell for the last 400 steps with no split or merge, aspect <= 1.5, area 0.6-1.6x the median. For each I branched an undamaged twin and a cut arm (twinrepair.py). Front cut, deleting the 40% of the cell's pixels furthest along its motion (44-53% of its links, 43-48% of its catalyst): on seeds 0 and 1 with world.damage (wound reset to bath S), 4/4 cells survive, rebuild a ring that scores >= 1.5 in 100% of second-half frames, and swim 1.8-4.7 body lengths in 3000 steps (twins 3.6-8.2). On seeds 3 and 4 with the wound's substrate left untouched (no fresh S), 3/4 re-close the ring: the share of the contour carrying links goes from 0.54-0.72 to >= 0.97 within 100-120 steps, and the cell is back to its pre-cut area at 280-340 steps. The fourth (seed 4, cell 29, already poorly ringed at the cut, closure 0.24) dies within 80 steps. Ring-only damage, setting the links to 0 in the cell and a 4 px margin while keeping its shape and catalyst, kills 4/4 cells (seeds 0-1) within 60-100 steps while their twins live. So the link ring holds the cell up, and the repair is the cell remaking it.

finding.operator: chi-adsorbed link ring on an Allen-Cahn cell with a tilt held up by its own links (phase_membrane), self-propelled by a phoretic drift
finding.control: exact branched undamaged twin for every cut; two wound treatments (bath S reset / S kept); ring-only erasure
finding.result: front 40% cut: 7/8 re-close the ring (closure >= 0.97 by +120) and regain pre-cut area (+280-340), 1/8 dies at +80; links-only erasure: 4/4 die at +60-100; twins all survive the same windows

limits: Cells in this world turn over (merge, divide, die) within about 1000-2000 steps, so after the repair window the cut cell and its twin diverge as any two cells do; the comparison that counts is the first ~400 steps. Wall smoothing is curvature flow plus the link tilt (by construction, scored under mechanism). Swimming after repair is not yet measured over a matched window: next loop, with saved tracks on fresh seeds 5-6. The seeds are c28's (0, 1) and new (3, 4).
